target.statement: Relative Frobenius norm error of the farness-reweighted IMCD covariance estimator (farness.IMCD) vs. classic estimator, for the smallest simulation cell (P=5, N=500, contamination ε=0.05, scenario 1: symmetric uniform latent variables, contamination in centers)
target.table_ref: Figure 2 (boxplots of relative Frobenius error, scenarios 1,2,4,5); Appendix C Figures C.7-C.16
target.dataset: Synthetic simulation data generated per Section 5.1 (multivariate normal centers/ranges, uniform or triangular latent microdata)

compute.basis: Target is a synthetic simulation (no external data); the IMCD/MM algorithm and adjusted-boxplot/farness cutoffs must be re-implemented from the paper's pseudocode (Appendix B) and R-package dependencies (robustbase, cellWise), and reproducing a stable boxplot cell requires many of the 500 Monte Carlo replicates at P=5, N=500 — CPU-only, minutes-to-hours of command time.

blockers: No explicit code/config release verified for the exact simulation; algorithm (MM/IMCD, reweighting, farness cutoff) must be re-implemented from pseudocode
Depends on R packages (robustbase adjbox, cellWise transfo) whose exact behavior must be matched
Full headline figure needs 96 parameter combinations × 500 samples; only a single cell is cheap
title: Minimum Covariance Determinant Estimator and Outlier Detection for Interval-valued Data
